name: joy
description: A long-term pattern of being able to retain a positive, satisfied, or happy mood even when negative outcomes are occurring in your world. It's based on internal factors like a sense of existential purpose, optimism, understanding, inherited traits, and/or faith.
perceptions: The world may not be perfect.
But I've got a place in it and there are worthwhile things.

guidance.description: Joy is the Holy Grail of personality traits. It can't be found out in the world, only inside. Here are some maps:

commentaries.quote: I define joy as a sustained sense of well-being and internal peace—a connection to what matters
Joy is a net of love by which you can catch souls.
I don't think of all the misery, but of the beauty that still remains.
Joy is the infallible sign of the presence of God.
I slept and dreamt that life was joy. I awoke and saw that life was service. I acted and behold, service was joy.
